name: Oc
summary: Ốc xào or ốc luộc is the afternoon snail plate on the city portal’s 24 November 2022 page. The snails stay whole. The seasonings it names are lemongrass, ginger, chili, and lime leaf.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page puts the plate after work in the afternoon.
howToEat: Order them stir-fried or boiled, whole, with the lemongrass, ginger, chili, and lime leaf the page names. A species was not printed. A street was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival. The 24 November 2022 city portal article says after the working afternoon. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Oc in Vinh — snails in the afternoon
seoDescription: Ốc in Vinh is a whole-snail plate, stir-fried or boiled, with lemongrass, ginger, chili, and lime leaf. A street and a price are Check on arrival.
